_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Thursday W17 — OpenAI counter-punch day after three days of Anthropic + Google dominance. (1) OpenAI launches GPT-5.5 — first new base model in a year: 'a new class of intelligence for real work and powering agents', gains concentrated in agentic coding / computer use / knowledge work / early scientific research; rolls to Plus / Pro / Business / Enterprise in ChatGPT + Codex; GPT-5.5 Pro for Pro / Business / Enterprise; API GA tomorrow. Pricing doubled: input $2.50 → $5.00 / 1M; output $15 → $30 / 1M; GPT-5.5 Pro stays $30 / $180. OpenAI says effective increase ~20% factoring token efficiency. Strongest safeguards to date — internal/external redteam + targeted cyber/bio testing + system card updated 24 April. (2) Anthropic publishes Claude Code regression investigation — admits dumbed-down behaviour March 4 → April 7: adjusted Claude Code default reasoning effort from high to medium on 4 March to reduce latency ('this was the wrong tradeoff'); caching bug + system-prompt change compounded; API not affected. Most explicit 'we got it wrong' public from a frontier lab in 2026. (3) Memory in Managed Agents moves to public beta — durable per-agent memory across sessions with policy + observability hooks, Claude Agent SDK + Claude Cowork; head-on competitor to Cloudflare Agent Memory (16 April private beta) — 'we own the agent runtime' play. (4) Software stocks plunge — ServiceNow −18% (worst day on record) citing Middle East 'headwind'; IBM drags; Salesforce / Workday / Oracle follow. Selloff broadens into re-rating of application SaaS as 'AI-vulnerable' — agents seen as the disintermediation risk earnings can't refute. Knowledge 2026 and Sapphire vendors arrive needing to prove agent-defensibility. Best long-form: Willison GPT-5.5 day-of ('fast, effective and highly capable'); Ben Thompson 'Myth and Mythos' — 'Anthropic Anthropic Anthropic' wearing the crown; Latent Space x Unsupervised Learning — 2026 = year coding agents 'break containment' and start doing everything else. Research: DR-Venus deep-research with only 10K open data, Reward Hacking survey, Near-Future Policy Optimization, Self-Evolving Terminal Agents via observational context compression, Scaling Test-Time Compute for Agentic Coding, Abstain-R1 calibrated abstention via verifiable RL, OpenMobile open mobile-agent stack, 'AI Scientists Produce Results Without Reasoning Scientifically' (sharp corrective to AI-scientist enthusiasm). STAGE MOVES: frontier-model-cadence + lab-services-gtm crescendo on GPT-5.5 / Memory in Managed Agents / GPT-5.5 Pro pricing; 'Application-SaaS AI-vulnerability re-rating' new emerging topic; ai-coding-agents fast EMA surges on GPT-5.5 agentic-coding positioning + Claude Code regression disclosure.
